{{Top|leg}}
A '''cutting blaster''' was designed to be used to clear trails in dense environments. It was not as accurate as a standard [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], and therefore was not as heavily restricted as weapons-quality blasters. The cutting blaster produced a "cold blast" of energy which lasted for a second and half and was capable of cutting down brush and small [[Tree/Legends|trees]]. It was referred to as a cold blast as the pulse was unlikely to produce a spark or start a fire. The weapon needed around four [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] to charge off of a standard [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] power systems.
